name: AutoResearchClaw
description: Pipeline that takes a research idea through literature review, experiments and a written paper, autonomously or with checkpoints.
whatItDoes: Turns a topic into a full research artefact, covering literature search, experiment design and execution, and manuscript drafting. Researchers can let it run unattended or approve stages in a co-pilot mode.
howItWorks: A staged pipeline driven by a YAML config calls an LLM for each phase and runs generated experiment code, with extensible skills. It is installed from source and controlled through its own CLI.

requirements.name: Python
requirements.description: Virtual environment for the editable install
